profile.summary: Experienced Producer and Event Project Manager with a demonstrated history of working in a variety of industries from investment management to entertainment. Skilled in Pro Tools, Event Management, Fundraising, and Marketing.

positions.title: Executive Assistant, Engineering (Management Operations)
positions.description:
Drive seamless and strategic communication and collaboration between members of the organization and the leadership team by producing quarterly All Hands meetings, monthly & weekly newsletters, monthly Q&A with Leadership, with a focus on inclusiveness for a distributed team
Manage, plan and run company wide Hack Weeks twice a year, including moving Hack Week to be fully virtual at the start of COVID
Constantly assess Engineering culture, identifying under-performing initiatives and problem areas and revamping them or creating
new programs. Created programs from helping with connections to celebrating wins to demystifying the internal transfer process.
Led redesign and update to department wide onboarding curriculum, collaborating with L&D Team, HRBPs, and Engineering
management

positions.title: Co-Founder & Lead Producer
positions.description:
•	Produce pop, rock, punk, jazz, and holiday albums, as well as voice-over tracks with established and emerging artists
•	Negotiate and develop collaborative projects with artists and symphonies to deepen audience base
•	Oversee and/or execute pre and post production – engineering, editing, mixing, mastering, file transfers, graphic design, upload to album distributor 
•	Manage any hired engineers, arrangers, orchestrators, lighting designers, stagehands and performers for live events and recordings
•	Create, produce and direct concerts, symphonic pops shows and live events across the US including multiple sold-out events in New York, Colorado, Oklahoma, Michigan and North Carolina
•	Develop and execute marketing strategies, including website design, photography, graphic design, and social media
•	Oversee digital and physical release of albums, including pricing, promotions, download exclusives and roadmaps
•	Work as second recording engineer including usage of Protools, Melodyne, and Garage Band
•	Manage database of all digital and hard copy charts and scores for orchestral and recording purposes including any duplication/adjustment thereof

positions.title: Event and Procurement Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Cultivate effective relationships with internal clients before, during and after events to ensure all needs are met
•	Negotiate and track contracts and pricing for all mid-level purchases through JIRA
•	Organize, document and enforce both internal and external facing standard operating procedures
•	Using historical data, evaluate and improve the process for all mid-level purchases to bring project delivery timeline to under 48 hours 
•	Manage all production and technical elements for internal events averaging 91 events a quarter

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description:
Program Specialist, Internal Communications
•	Produced quarterly Town Halls with an attendance averaging 2,000 annually including management of streaming, and recording / editing archival footage.
•	Created and ran a series of company-wide talks while recording and storing the audio and video, circa 30 events a year
•	Designed and maintained company-wide websites (1100+ employees) including new hire welcome, and Engineering division pages
•	Managed and delivered on-site / external team-wide events for up to 300+ engineers
Executive Assistant
•	Supported the Chief Technology Officer and Chief Information Officer as well as a number of other C-level managing directors
•	Managed daily / monthly business-related expenses
•	Served as project liaison between Engineering leadership teams and their staff

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
Office Manager
•	Reconciled monthly financials for seven entities
•	Managed and led New York office staff during the absence of President and VPs
•	Directed the New York office’s move to a paperless office including the digitalization of 20+ years of files
Executive Assistant
•	Managed business and personal affairs for the President and two Vice Presidents

positions.title: Backstage Attendant
positions.description:
•	Guest artist liaison for conductors and high profile guest artists for Stern Auditorium and Zankel Hall
•	Managed  / provided for all artist needs while at Carnegie Hall
•	Coordination of artists movements to/from the stage and throughout the venue for the duration of their event, ensuring artist safety, comfort and privacy

positions.title: Backstage Manager
positions.description:
Guest Artist Liaison
•	Project managed backstage operations for theatre rentals, including Late Night with Jimmy Fallon’s Super Bowl XLVI 
•	Oversaw all guest artist needs during performances and rehearsals
Production Assistant
•	Managed two direct reports and trained interns in Production Assistant role
•	Maintained comprehensive log of costumes, scores and script updates, and ensured performers and directors had most updated and correct version(s)

positions.title: Executive Assistant to the President and Music Director
positions.description:
•	Co-founded Music as Medicine™ program with Board President and Indiana University-Purdue University Fort Wayne Music Therapy department
•	Created concert series with the Music Director
•	Produced an organization-wide employee recognition program
•	Trained and led all volunteers and interns (over 250) for fundraising activities over the course of the season
•	Managed the business affairs for CEO and Music Director
•	Coordinated annual meetings, including live television broadcasts

projects.title: Love on Broadway - Symphonic Pops Show
projects.description: Beth Leavel (Drowsy Chaperone (Tony®, Drama Desk, NY Outer Critics Circle, L.A. Drama Critics Award), Baby, It's You (Tony®, Drama Desk and Outer Critics Circle nomination), Elf, Mamma Mia!) and Adam Heller (Elf, Les Miserables, Baby, It's You, Merrily We Roll Along) join Nikki Renée Daniels (Porgy and Bess (Tony Award® Best Musical), Les Mis, Promises, Promises) and husband Jeff Kready (Gentleman’s Guide to Murder (Tony Award® Best Musical), Les Mis, Billy Elliot) with Stephen Trafton (Les Mis, Phantom of the Opera) and wife Juliette Trafton (Phantom of the Opera, The Fantasticks) to sing and tell about the ups, downs and all arounds of love, life and marriage on the Great White Way. Real songs, real stories, real love: This is LOVE ON BROADWAY.

projects.title: Fairy Tale Fantasia - Symphonic Pops Show
projects.description: Imagine this: a solo spotlight on a narrator who opens the concerts with one of Hans Christian Anderson's vivid fairy tales.  As the story progresses, the lights slowly come up on the orchestra who take over for the narrator with the haunting music of Grieg, Tchaikovsky and Beethoven.  As the orchestra continues to unfold the tale, you begin to notice the live illustrations from our illustrator who brings the fairy tale further to life picture by picture as the illustration is projected on a screen for all to see.  This dance between narrator, orchestra and illustrator continues as the story reaches its end.  With 2 hour, 90 minute and 60 minute versions, this show is sure to be fun for the entire family.
